title: Beyond the Name: Demographic Leakage in De-Identified R\'esum\'es and Evaluation Artifacts in LLM Bias Audits
abstract: arXiv:2609.16501v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: De-identified r\'esum\'e screening assumes that redacting explicit fields prevents ethnocultural inference; however, recent audits attribute residual leakage to declared languages. We investigate whether eliminating language fields resolves this leakage across nine open-weight models and 620 counterfactual r\'esum\'es. By holding language attributes strictly identical, we isolate unstructured prose across five ethnocultural conditions and three cue-salience tiers. Target-group recovery averages 0.757 overall and saturates at 1.000 under high salience, demonstrating that non-language prose sustains demographic inference. Crucially, models diverge only under faint cues (0.086-0.690), establishing salience as an essential evaluation axis. translated_title: 不仅仅是姓名：去标识化简历中的人口统计信息泄露与LLM偏见审计中的评估伪影
translated_abstract: 去标识化简历筛选假定隐去显性字段即可防止族裔文化推断；然而，近期的审计将残余泄露归因于所声明的语言。我们研究了在九个开放权重模型和620份反事实简历上，消除语言字段是否能解决这种泄露问题。通过严格控制语言属性完全一致，我们在五个族裔文化条件和三个线索显著性层级中分离出非结构化文本的影响。目标群体的识别率总体平均为0.757，且在高显著性下饱和达到1.000，这表明非语言的文本内容足以支撑人口统计推断。至关重要的是，各模型仅在面对微弱线索时才出现分化（0.086-0.690），这确立了线索显著性是一项必要的评估维度。此外，成对的“大模型作为评判者”的结果对评估设计高度敏感：禁止平局判定会产生表观选择率比为0.39，同时伴随强烈的职位与内容效应。
tldr: 该研究证明即使完全移除语言字段，去标识化简历中的非语言文本仍能维持人口统计推断，且大模型评判结果高度依赖评估设计，揭示线索显著性与评估方法选择是LLM偏见审计中不可忽视的关键因素。
en_tdlr: This study demonstrates that non-language prose in de-identified résumés sustains demographic inference even when language fields are eliminated, and that LLM-as-a-judge outcomes are highly sensitive to evaluation design, establishing cue salience and evaluation methodology as essential axes in LLM bias audits.
